name: verify-verdict
_comment: /verify-implementation's report ends with a machine-read verdict line: skill-chain scripts gate /absorb-design on it, and a verdict written only as prose ('implemented as specified') stalls the chain.

items.fix: /verify-implementation's report must carry its verdict as the line `Design conformance: PROVEN` or `Design conformance: INCOMPLETE` (the skill's report template). Scripts read that line to decide whether to absorb the design. Send the report again with the line.
